limitations.note: The patch left yellow and red combinational instead of registering them from the pre-update balance on the rising edge, and changed the billing logic so that a recharge no longer takes priority over deduction.

The testbench expected the warnings to respond immediately to balance and boost changes and modeled a debit on recharge cycles, so its PASS confirmed the patch’s assumptions rather than the required behavior.
The search focused on billing terms and the agent did not open the listed registered-output or delayed-counter entries that could have helped it investigate warning timing.
